something on screen, the exact words help more than a description of them.

## Before you send this

- Check whether the same thing happens with a different source selected in the download sheet. The
  catalogues are separate servers and one of them may be the one that is unwell.
- A failed download usually names the reason on the row. That line is the most useful part of the
  report.
- Please do not post a signed download link or a key. A signed link is a credential until it
  expires, and there is a private channel for that: **Security** on the repository page.
